about: Sitting 4, again, written by hand on 7 Oct 2026 at the owner's word ('We need to redo the girls dorms as there are doors that lead to nothing'): the girls' corridor redone in place from the game's own picture, with ONE named change in the keep text: only the nearest door on each side stays (Nobara's on the left, Maki's on the right); every other door becomes plain wall.
